name: garmin-personal-api-mcp
description: Read-only access to your own Garmin Connect activities, VO2 max, sleep, HRV, Body Battery and weight, via Garmin's official Personal API.
long_description:
Ask Claude about your training and recovery using your own Garmin Connect data. Activities come with exact per-km splits computed from the original .FIT file, plus sleep, HRV, Body Battery, stress, steps, weight and nutrition.

Everything runs on your computer: the extension exchanges your Personal API key for a 24-hour token with Garmin and makes read-only GET requests. No data passes through any third-party server.

You need a Garmin Connect account and a Personal API key: Garmin Connect → Settings → Personal API → Create Key (https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken).

This is an independent project, not made or endorsed by Garmin. "Garmin" and "Garmin Connect" are trademarks of Garmin Ltd.

api_key.title: Garmin Personal API key
api_key.description: Create one at https://connect.garmin.com/app/settings/personalApiToken (Garmin Connect → Settings → Personal API → Create Key), copy it, and paste it here. The key is read-only and only reads your own account. When it expires, create a new one and paste it here again.

tools.name: garmin_get_profile
tools.description: Your Garmin profile settings (units, weight, height, birth year, lactate threshold where set) plus heart-rate zones.

tools.name: garmin_list_activities
tools.description: List recorded activities (runs, gym sessions, rides…), newest first, with distance, time, pace and heart rate.

tools.name: garmin_get_activity
tools.description: Garmin's computed summary for one activity: distance, durations, pace/speed, HR, cadence, elevation, training effect, calories.

tools.name: garmin_get_activity_splits
tools.description: Exact distance splits from the original .FIT file (interpolated, pauses excluded), per-split HR, cadence and climb, device laps, and a pacing verdict.

tools.name: garmin_get_performance_metrics
tools.description: Your VO2 max as Garmin Connect shows it, its readings over time, plus per-activity training effect and recovery time, decoded from the activity files.

tools.name: garmin_download_activity_fit
tools.description: Save an activity's original file to a folder on this computer, for Runalyze, Golden Cheetah and similar tools.

tools.name: garmin_get_day
tools.description: One day in one call: daily summary, sleep, overnight HRV, Body Battery and activities.

tools.name: garmin_get_daily_summaries
tools.description: Per-day totals: steps, calories, resting/min/max heart rate, stress, intensity minutes, floors, Body Battery high/low.

tools.name: garmin_get_sleep
tools.description: Per-night sleep: duration, deep/light/REM/awake time, sleep score and timing.

tools.name: garmin_get_hrv
tools.description: Per-night heart-rate variability: last-night average, weekly average, baseline range and status.

tools.name: garmin_get_body_battery
tools.description: Per-day Body Battery: charged, drained, highest and lowest values.

tools.name: garmin_get_stress
tools.description: Per-day all-day stress levels.

tools.name: garmin_get_steps
tools.description: Per-day step totals and goals.

tools.name: garmin_get_hydration
tools.description: Per-day logged water intake and goal.

tools.name: garmin_get_weight
tools.description: Every weigh-in in a range, with BMI, body fat, muscle mass and water where a smart scale recorded them.

tools.name: garmin_get_weight_goals
tools.description: Weight goals in effect during a range.

tools.name: garmin_get_wellness_activities
tools.description: Wellness activity summaries (e.g. breathwork and relaxation sessions) for a range.

tools.name: garmin_get_sleep_detail
tools.description: One night's sleep in full: stages timeline, score breakdown, respiration, restless moments, SpO2 and HR.

tools.name: garmin_get_heart_rate
tools.description: One day's resting HR and all-day heart-rate samples.

tools.name: garmin_get_spo2
tools.description: One day's SpO2 readings and acclimation.

tools.name: garmin_get_fitness_age
tools.description: Garmin's fitness age estimate and its inputs for a date.

tools.name: garmin_get_nutrition
tools.description: Foods and macros logged in Garmin Connect's nutrition log for one day.

tools.name: garmin_api_get
tools.description: Read-only GET to any other documented Personal API endpoint (e.g. menstrual cycle summaries, activity workouts).
